replay.name: blaze-server-routes
replay.label: Three visitors, Blaze (a real hackathon entry, MIT, unedited), 22 Oct
replay.diagnosis: Kind 2, a harness limit. Blaze is a server app. Its links such as /createwiki and /logout are routes that only its own backend answers, and we served the files without that backend, so the visitors got 404s. This is our setup, not a defect in Blaze.
